questions.question: If x and y are real numbers, then the least possible value of 4 (x – 2)² + (y – 3)² – 2 (x – 3)² is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

4(x – 2)² + (y – 3)² – 2(x – 3)²

**Calculation:**

4 (x – 2)2 + (y – 3)2 – 2 (x – 3)2

For least possible value put (y – 3)² = 0

4(x – 2)² – 2(x – 3)²

⇒ 4(x² + 4 – 4x) – 2(x² + 9 – 6x)

⇒ 4x² + 16 – 16x – 2x² – 18 + 12x

⇒ 2x² – 2 – 4x

⇒ 2(x² – 1 – 2x)

⇒ 2(x² + 1 – 2x – 2)

⇒ 2[(x – 1)² – 2]

As we know,

For least possible value put (x – 1)² = 0

⇒ 2 × (-2) = -4

questions.question: A person takes 40 minutes more than his usual time when he covers a distance of 20 km at 5 km/h. If he covers the same distance at 8 km/h, he takes x minutes less than the usual time. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of man = 5 km/h

Distance = 20 km

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time

**Calculation:**

As we know,

Time = Distance/Speed = 20/5 = 4 hr

Usual time = 4 hr – 40 min = 3 hr and 20 min

Second condition

Speed of man = 8 km/hr

Time = Distance /Speed = 20/8 = 2 hr 30 min

Time difference = (3 hr + 20 min) – (2 hr + 30 min) = 50 min 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

According to the question,

⇒ [(5 × 8)/(8 – 5)] × [(40 + x)/60] = 20

⇒ [40/3] × [(40 + x)/60] = 20 

⇒ (40 + x) = (20 × 60 × 3)/40 = 90

⇒ x = 90 – 40

∴ x = 50

questions.question: The average weight of the boys in a class is 69.3 kg and that of the girls in the same class is 59.4 kg. If the average weight of all the boys and girls in the class is 63.8 kg, then the percentage of the number of boys in the class is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average weight of boys = 69.3 kg

Average weight of girls = 59.4 kg

Average weight of all boys and girls = 63.8 kg

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of terms/Total no of terms

**Calculation:**

Let the no og boys be x.

And no of girls be y.

Sum of weight of all boys = Average of all boys × No of boys in class

∴ Sum of weight of all the boys = 69.3x kg

Likewise,

Sum of weight of all the girls = 59.4y kg

Similarly,

Total weight of class = 63.8(x + y) kg

Since,

Sum of weight of boys + Sum of weight of girls = Total weight of class

⇒ 69.3x + 59.4y = 63.8(x + y)

⇒ 5.5x = 4.4y

⇒ x/y = 4/5

Total no of boys and girls = 9

∴ Percentage of boys in the class = (4/9) × 100 = 44(4)/(9)%

∴ The correct answer is **44.44%**.

questions.question: If 21 tan θ = 20, then (1 + sin θ + cos θ) : (1 – sin θ + cos θ) = ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

21 tan θ = 20

tan θ = 20/21

**Formula used:**

tan θ = Perpendicular/Base 

Sin θ = Perpendicular/hypotaneous

Cos θ = Base/hypotaneous

(Hypotenuse)2 = (Perpendicular)2 + (Base)2

**Calculation:**

If,

tan θ = Perpendicular/Base = 20/21

(Hypotenuse)² = (Perpendicular)² + (Base)²

(Hypotenuse)² = (20)² + (21)²

(Hypotenuse)² = 400 + 441 = 841

Hypotenuse = √841 = 29

Now,

⇒ (1 + sin θ + cos θ) : (1 – sin θ + cos θ)

⇒ (1 + 20/29 + 21/29) : (1 – 20/29 + 21/29)

⇒ [(29 + 20 + 21)/29] : [(29 – 20 + 21)/29]

⇒ 70 : 30

⇒ 7 : 3

∴ The correct answer is **7 : 3**.

questions.question: The curved surface area of a right circular cone is 156π and the radius of its base is 12 cm. What is the volume of the cone, in cm³?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Curved surface area of cone = 156π 

Radius = 12 cm

**Formula used:**

Curved surface area of cone = πrl

Vomume of cone = (1/3)πr²h

L = √(r² + h²) 

L= slant height

**Calculation:**

Radius of cone = r = 12 cm

Curved surface area of cone = πrl

⇒ πrl = 156π

⇒ 12 × l = 156

l = 13

l² = r² + h²

⇒ 13² = 12² + h²

⇒ h² = 169 – 144 = 25

⇒ h = √25 = 5 cm

Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h

⇒ 1/3 × π × 12 × 12 × 5 = 240π

∴ The correct answer is** 240π**.

questions.question: The average of n observations is 40. If one observation of value 80 is added, then the average of all the observations is 41. What is the value of n?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of n observations = 40

One value 80 is added so average becomes 41

**Formula used:**

Sum = Average × number of observations

**Calculation:**

Sum of n observation = 40n

Average of (n + 1) observation = 41

Sum of (n + 1) observation = (41) × (n + 1)

According to the question

40n + 80 = 41(n + 1)

40n + 80 = 41n + 41

41n – 40n = 80 – 41

n = 39

**So, number of observation be 39**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/456affb41122b962167707f86667cfa3b79071d29d93cd973708d961a6b22a7c.png] 

The new number added = (n)(1) + (1)(41)

⇒ n + 41 = 80

⇒ n = 39

**∴ The correct answer is 39.**

questions.question: The sides of a triangular park are 35 m, 53 m and 66 m. The cost of levelling the park at the rate of Rs. 9.25/m² is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sides of the triangular park = 35 m, 53 m and 66 m

The cost of levelling = Rs. 9.25/m²

**Formula used:**

Semi perimeter (s) = (a + b + c)/2

Area of triangle = √s(s – a)(s – b)(s – c)

**Calculation:**

⇒ s = (35 + 53 + 66)/2 = 154/2 = 77

Area of triangle = √s(s – a)(s – b)(s – c)

⇒ √{77(77 – 35)(77 – 53)(77 – 66)} = √{77 × 7 × 6 × 6 × 4 × 11}

⇒ 11 × 7 × 6 × 2 = 924

Cost of levelling of 1 m² = 9.25

Cost of levelling of 924 m² = 9.25 × 924 = 8547 

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 8547**

A person sold a chair at a profit of 13%.

Profit% = (Profit/C.P) × 100

questions.question: In ΔABC, ∠A = 90°, AB = 16 cm and AC = 12 cm. D is the midpoint of AC and DE ⊥ CB at E. What is the area (in cm²) of ΔCDE?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In ΔABC, ∠A = 90°, AB = 16 cm and AC = 12 cm.

D is the midpoint of AC and DE ⊥ CB at E.

**Concept used:**

Area of triangle = (1/2) × base × height

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/711f2a5a2c612faedb762652020448e02a892cf9bf5d0d8fa9093a2a8df3bbc9.png] 

In ΔABC

BC² = AB² + AC²

BC² = 16² + 12² = 256 + 144 = 400

BC = √400 = 20

Area of ΔABC = (1/2) × 12 × 16 = 96 cm²

As we know,

ΔABC ∼ ΔEDC

(Area of ΔEDC)/(Area of ΔABC) = (DC/BC)²

(Area of ΔEDC)/96 = (6/20)² = 36/400

Area of ΔEDC = (36/400) × 96 = 8.64 cm²

questions.question: A invests Rs. 6,00,000 more than B in a business. B invests his capital for 7(1)/(2) months, while A invests his capital for 2(1)/(2) more months than B. Out of the total profit of Rs. 12,40,000, if the share of B is Rs. 2,48,000 less than the share of A, then the capital of B is:
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

Profit = Investment × Time

**Calculation:**

Total profit = 12,40,000

Let profit of A be x

Profit of B = x – 248000

x + x – 2,48,000 = 12,40,000

2x = 12,40,000 + 2,48,000

2x = 1488000

x = 744000

Profit of A = 744000

Profit of B = 744000 – 248000 = 496000

Let money invested by B be Rs y.

Money invested by A = y + 600000

Time for B = 7(1)/(2) = frac{{15}}{2} months

Time for A = 7(1)/(2) + 2(1)/(2) = 10 months

As we know,

Capital × Time = Profit

(y + 6,00,000) × 10 : y × (15/2) = 744000 : 496000

10 (y + 6,00,000) : 15y/2 = 3 : 2

4 (y + 6,00,000) : 3y = 3 : 2

(4y + 24,00,000)/3y = 3/2

8y + 48,00,000 = 9y

9y – 8y = 48,00,000

y = 48,00,000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

As we know,

Capital × Time = Profit

Profit share of A to B = 3 : 2

Time ratio of A to B = 10 : 15/2 = 4 : 3

According to the question

4A/3B = 3/2

A/B = 9/8

So, capital ratio of A to B = 9 : 8

(9 – 8) = 1 unit = 6,00,000

8 unit = 6,00,000 × 8 = 48,00,00

questions.question: In school, 60% of the number of students are boys and the rest are girls. If 20% of the number of boys failed and 65% of the number of girls passed the examination, then the percentage of the total number of students who passed is:
questions.solution:
Let total number be students be 100

Number of boys = 100 × (60/100) = 60

Number of girls = 100 – 60 = 40

Number of passed boys = 60 × (80/100) = 48

Number of passed girls = 40 × (65/100) = 26

Total passed students = 48 + 26 = 74

Required percentage = (74/100) × 100 = 74%
